items.q: Can I switch plans halfway through a year?
items.a: Yes. Moving up is charged for the days left; moving down is credited to your next bill.

items.q: What happens to my invoices if I leave?
items.a: You keep read access for 90 days and can export everything as PDF and CSV.
No. Every plan sends unlimited invoices.
